command_argv: import win32job,win32api,os;j=win32job.OpenJobObject(win32job.JOB_OBJECT_QUERY,False,os.environ['MDD_BASELINE_JOB_NAME']);inside=win32job.IsProcessInJob(win32api.GetCurrentProcess(),j);d=win32job.QueryInformationJobObject(j,win32job.JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation);j.Close();flags=d['BasicLimitInformation']['LimitFlags'];ok=inside and d['JobMemoryLimit']==536870912 and flags & win32job.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE;print('child actual Job limits verified',ok);exit(0 if ok else 4)
